procedures.procedure_name: ASTM E679 Ascending concentration series method of limits
steps: Conduct the test with 25 panelists using 3-AFC tests at six concentrations of 3-Methyl-2-butene-1-thiol in beer.
Record and analyze results to determine the best estimate threshold (BET) for each subject.
Use a dynamic olfactometer to determine the threshold of isovaleric acid in air with 20 panelists.
Conduct tests at concentrations spaced twofold apart and calculate individual and group thresholds.
